title: Pre-replay correction-target eligibility classification
classification_timing: Eligibility was assigned against the current detector contracts and exact source/correction descriptions before the current-code corpus replay.
limitations: The source and correction records were visible during prior development and adjudication; this is not an independent or blinded evaluation.
Eligibility is a case-level mechanism classification. Each selected case may contain more than one corrected cell.
The classification does not establish scientific consequence, clinical importance, or effect on a paper conclusion.
The wave-2 correction corpus was originally judged post-lock; this reclassification is a later development assessment.

cases.issue_class: Table 3 reports 2 cases among 71 as 2.9%; the correction says this should be 2.8%. The nearby 1/78 = 1.4% result is retained because it uses a different definition and denominator.
cases.basis: The target denominator 71 appears in a body subgroup row; current JATS table contract only resolves explicit column-header denominators.

cases.issue_class: The correction says all Table 2 rates were displayed at half their corrected values due to an annualization error; doctor rate 14.5 is corrected to 29.0 per 1,000 practitioner-years.
cases.basis: The correction changes an adjusted annualized rate; numerator, person-time construction, and fitted adjustment are not independently recomputable from explicit operands.

cases.issue_class: The Results section lists 17,708 at baseline, exclusions 1,841, 2,789, 1,878, and 140, then 12,417 included. The correction says 1,841 should be 484; with that change, the flow arithmetic matches 12,417.
cases.basis: The source has a prose-shaped flow, but no source-mapped flow graph establishes disjointness, exhaustiveness, and same-scope operands; the active locator only returns an unresolved question.

cases.issue_class: Table 2 reports 23/30 as 73.3% for Group 1 and 70% for Group 2; the correction states both values should be 76.7%.
cases.basis: JATS Table 2 has two count/percentage cells with explicit per-group n=30 headers; the displayed precision and denominator scope are explicit, and no row footnote, missing-data, weighted, adjusted, or overlap cue modifies these operands.
The original values use numerator/denominator/percentage syntax (11/233 (1.8%)); that cell syntax is not in the active count (percentage) table contract.

cases.issue_class: table percentage transcription error with row-specific denominator
cases.basis: The corrected percentage depends on a footnote-specific local denominator; footnoted row scope is excluded.
The Male row has a footnote stating sex data were unknown for 3 cases; row-label footnote scope is excluded by the current contract.
The correction changes narrative percentages without explicit numerator/denominator operands; a count-marker conflict cannot map the correction.
The correction targets percent-only cells and a row-sum relation; row totals/percentage sums are not implemented.
The correction is a prose/table synthesis-count relationship; PRISMA/synthesis arithmetic and cross-section source mapping are not active.

cases.issue_class: corrected participant demographic and diagnosis counts
cases.basis: The correction targets count-only demographic rows and prose/table reconciliation, not a same-cell count/percentage relation.
The correction changes follow-up-window classification and timepoint-linked ratios; source-mapped flow and rate checks are not active.
The correction is a count-only table digit omission with no explicit count/percentage arithmetic relation.

cases.issue_class: missing-data miscoding followed by corrected statistical reanalysis
cases.basis: The correction changes missing-data recoding and adjusted multivariable estimates; a fitted-model recalculation is excluded.
The correction is count-only demographic categories; row/column-total checks are not implemented.

cases.issue_class: correction of reported exposure rates, event rates, and percentages
cases.basis: The correction includes exposure rates, event rates, rate differences, and percent values without one exact count/percentage cell meeting the active table contract.
